title: Independent review of school therapy pilot-market selection
scope: Review of selection.json and the six research inputs: challengers, texas, carolina-georgia, midatlantic, state-credential-fit and buyer-risk. This review concerns research claims and recommendation logic, not a rendered HTML review, legal clearance, credit approval or live procurement eligibility.
conclusion: Rockland County, New York is defensible as the first validation priority in this bounded screen. East Ramapo is the strongest current direct-buyer lead for a narrow in-person SLP assignment; Rockland BOCES is an adjacent second lead. This is not evidence that the unknown company can submit a compliant bid, that assignments exist for it, or that the region has superior supply or margins. Frederick is a useful ongoing-route alternative only after its agency-history and client-reference conditions are resolved.

findings.finding: Several access claims are supported by research inputs but not by the source IDs attached to the summary. The decision's Frederick statement lacks MAS01–MAS03; the Maryland comparison cites only credential sources; North Carolina, Virginia and Georgia access summaries likewise lack the relevant procurement sources. New York's corporate-exception summary should cite CLS16/CLS17.
findings.required_fix: Attach the actual procurement sources to each summary claim and include the relevant corporate-authority source. Preserve each district's own evidence links in the report.
findings.disposition: Re-read selection.json: the decision now cites Frederick procurement and New York corporate-authority sources; MD/NC/VA/GA summaries cite the relevant procurement sources; the NY state row includes CLS16 and CLS17. District records retain their source links.

findings.finding: Frederick is selected by district_name_match instead of the stable district_id used elsewhere, weakening deterministic source-to-recommendation linkage.
findings.required_fix: Use district_id MAD01 and validate that every ranked buyer resolves to exactly one district record.
findings.disposition: Re-read selection.json after the fix: rank 3 now uses district_id MAD01, which resolves to Frederick County Public Schools.

accepted_checks: The recommendation is expressly conditional, the user's entity and workforce readiness are unverified rather than assumed absent, and a one-clinician pilot is labeled as the team's proposed scope.

Open procurements, conditional ongoing qualification, application channels, closed solicitations and unverified portal leads remain distinct. Registration, award eligibility and authorized orders are not conflated.
New York City independent-provider registration is correctly separated from district staffing as an RSA voucher channel; published session reimbursement is not treated as hourly revenue or margin.
New York's agency school-age SLP dual-credential requirement and SLP-specific corporate exception are kept separate from OT/PT entity and role questions.
Compact membership is not treated as issued practice authority or as a provider-mobility advantage in any of the six shortlisted states.

Frederick's agency work history, client references, in-person requirement and agency-subcontracting restriction are material gates rather than assumed satisfiable through a clinician's personal experience.
Birdville's imminent deadline and conflicting secondary deadline remain unresolved; Mesquite's rolling status and Elgin's identifier mismatch are not presented as verified open therapy awards.

East Ramapo's dated fiscal projections and oversight are balanced against the monitor's positive budget assessment; neither buyer is cleared for credit or asserted to have a verified late-payment/default history.
Statewide ASHA certification counts are labeled as context, not all licensees, available local clinicians, staffing vacancies or a readiness score.
Licensed clinicians retain therapy judgment and schools retain IEP authority. No right to send student data to an AI system is inferred from a staffing opportunity.

primary_spot_checks.result: Rockland's current listing confirms separate speech, OT and PT RFPs due October 29, 2026 at 11 a.m. East Ramapo's current page lists SLP RFP-ER-5-27 and Addendum 1 under open listings.

primary_spot_checks.method: Fresh ordinary HTTPS PDF retrieval and pdftotext extraction after the web reader failed
primary_spot_checks.result: Verified in-person-only services, individual proposed clinician resumes/references with the proposal, later candidate additions after a contract, and assignments ranging from individual part-time sessions to leave replacement.

primary_spot_checks.method: Fresh ordinary HTTPS PDF retrieval; original PDF pages 43, 46 and 59 text inspected
primary_spot_checks.result: Verified conditional qualification of additional providers during the term, same bid requirements and competitive rates, five-year agency-history provision with position caveat, five agency-client references, and restriction on subcontracted agencies.

primary_spot_checks.method: Fresh official NYSED credential matrix and New York Education Law §8208 retrieval
primary_spot_checks.result: The stated agency/contract school speech model requires both credentials. The law expressly permits corporate SLP/audiology practice through licensed or exempt persons; this does not authorize OT/PT by analogy.

data_integrity.method: Parsed all seven JSON files, checked source-ID uniqueness and recursively resolved source_ids references. The result is referential integrity, not proof that every source supports every sentence.

preserve_in_final: Call New York/Rockland a validation priority within the screened markets, not an established best long-term market or bid-ready launch.
Keep exact October deadlines and the need to recheck addenda visible; do not imply that a new company should rush a bid.
State that no immediately launch-ready district is established if named qualified clinicians, references, insurance and business readiness cannot be evidenced.
Retain actual funded orders, clinician availability, payment terms and payroll liquidity as unresolved go/no-go evidence.
Do not claim visual/browser QA, live portal access, buyer contact, reference verification, a legal opinion or a credit assessment from this review.
release_note: Both traceability findings were corrected and the changed fields independently rechecked. No recommendation-blocking factual contradiction was identified in the reviewed data or limited primary-source spot checks. Root will rebuild the report and run its structural and filter checks; this review makes no rendered-browser or live-service claim.

artifact_source_check.result: The conditional recommendation, bid dates, firm-readiness gates, independent-provider channel distinction, state credential qualifications, balanced buyer-risk section and sensitivity cases are visible in the HTML source. The independent-review area was pending when inspected and must be rebuilt after this review is finalized.
